verses.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: Command the children of Israel to send out from the camp every wicked person, every sinner, and everyone who is corrupt in heart.
verses.3: Remember this: You must send them out to the outside of the camp. Do not cover their campsites, where I am staying among them.
verses.4: And so did the children of Israel. They sent them out into the wilderness, as Jehovah had commanded Moses. That is what the children of Israel did.
verses.5: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.6: Let it be said to the children of Israel, both men and women: That whoever commits any of these sins against God, shall be punished severely.
verses.7: And they humbled themselves before their sins, which they had committed. They atoned for their sins by putting them on their heads. Their five fingers were bound together, and he gave those who were guilty to him.
verses.8: And if a man has no one to take the blame upon himself, then that blame shall be taken upon the priest, just as the oxen are burdened with the weight of their own sins.
verses.9: And every offering that the Israelites bring to the priest shall be accepted.
verses.10: And he shall have his sacred objects; he shall be a man who will give them to the priest.
verses.11: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.12: I spoke to the children of Israel and said to them, “Each man must divorce his wife, and not allow her to remain with him any longer.”
verses.13: And a man lay with her, in the state of seed. He disappeared from her eyes. She was hidden away, and he was also hidden away. They were both buried together, and no one knew where they were.
verses.14: And a spirit of jealousy and longing for his wife overcame him. He died, but a spirit of jealousy and longing for his wife still remained with him. His wife, however, was not buried.
verses.15: And the man brought his wife before the priest. He also brought her offering: fine flour, honey, and sesame seeds. None of these things should be used as a sacrifice; they were meant to be offered as offerings of remembrance, as a reminder of the past.
verses.16: And the priest brought her forward, and she stood before Jehovah.
verses.17: And the priest shall take holy water from the ground and from the clouds that are in the sky above. He shall then pour this water into the water containers.
verses.18: And the priest stood before Jehovah, and he uncovered the woman’s head. Then he placed upon her head the offering of remembrance, the offering of jealousy. And in the hand of the priest were the blood of the bulls and lambs.
verses.19: And the priest shall take her away, and say to her, “If no man has slept with you, and if there is no shame under your husband’s bed, then you may be cleansed from these unclean things.”
verses.20: And you are like a slave under your husband’s control; you are worthless. Your husband will give you his bed, but only after he has gotten rid of you from his life.
verses.21: And the priest shall lay the woman on the altar. Then the priest shall say to her, “May the LORD give you to Alah and to his people as a sign of the LORD’s holiness. Your legs shall be broken, and your belly shall be cut open.”
verses.22: And these salty waters came in, covering the rocks with their liquid. The woman said, “Truly, I tell you.”
verses.23: And the priest shall write down these words in a book, and sprinkle them on the waters.
verses.24: And she filled the vessels with the bitter waters. Then, those bitter waters flowed into the vessels.
verses.25: And the priest took the offering from the woman’s hands, and he held it before Jehovah. Then he offered it to the priest.
verses.26: And the priest took the offering from the altar, and he lit the incense. After that, he poured water over the woman.
verses.27: And she filled the water with her body; she became like a corpse. The water rushed over her body. Her legs fell down, and she became like a dead woman. She was in the midst of her people.
verses.28: And if the woman does not beget children, and she is purified and becomes chaste, then she may plant seeds.
verses.29: This is the law regarding jealousy: a woman shall not be jealous of her husband.
verses.30: Or a man who is filled with jealousy and envy towards his wife. He brings her before Jehovah, and the priest then gives her all these laws.
verses.31: And the man will be freed from his slavery, and the woman will carry her slave.
